versions.changelog: Version 4.0.1 - Minor update to address review feedback and improve security declarations

Major update: Comprehensive regulatory upgrade for 2024–2026.

- Updated to support current and forthcoming (2025–2026) China banking regulations and international standards (Basel III CN 2024, FATF 2025 eval, revised AML regs, upgraded consumer protection).
- Expanded compliance coverage: marketing materials, KYC/AML reviews, CBIRC/NFRA/PIPL checks, regulatory reporting templates.
- New compliance checklists, review templates, and output formats for easier workflow integration.
- Fully updated guidance/examples for risk screening, due diligence, and materials review in both English and Chinese.
- Triggers and keywords expanded for more user-friendly queries.
